instruction:
You are an electrical design engineer checking `SSC-05-LH-03`, a task-owned synthetic SSC-05 switchboard fault, arc-flash, and earthing package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values below for numeric grading. ETAP, EasyPower, SKM PowerTools, arc-flash, and earthing workflows shape the context only; this instance does not run those tools or parse a real SLD, relay curve, fault-study export, or earthing model.

## Scene

- Design case: `CASE-SSC05-SWBD-03`
- Single-line diagram: `SLD-05-SWBD-03`
- Fault study table: `FAULT-05-STUDY-03`
- Relay/protection setting sheet: `RELAY-05-SET-03`
- Soil and earthing record: `EARTH-05-SOIL-03`
- Switchboard layout: `LAYOUT-05-SWBD-03`
- Safety note: `NOTE-05-SAFETY-03`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Utility fault level | {{ utility_fault_mva }} MVA |
| Switchboard voltage | {{ switchboard_voltage_v }} V |
| Transformer contribution | {{ transformer_contribution_ka }} kA |
| Motor contribution | {{ motor_contribution_ka }} kA |
| Switchboard fault rating | {{ switchboard_fault_rating_ka }} kA |
| Arcing-current factor | {{ arcing_current_factor }} |
| Clearing time | {{ clearing_time_s }} s |
| Incident-energy factor | {{ incident_energy_factor }} |
| Working distance | {{ working_distance_m }} m |
| Allowable incident energy | {{ allowable_incident_energy_cal_cm2 }} cal/cm2 |
| Earth-grid resistance | {{ earth_grid_resistance_ohm }} ohm |
| Touch-voltage limit | {{ touch_voltage_limit_v }} V |
| Busbar force factor | {{ busbar_force_factor }} |
| Busbar force rating | {{ busbar_force_rating_kn }} kN |

Checks:

- Utility fault current equals `utility_fault_mva x 1000 / (sqrt(3) x switchboard_voltage_v)`.
- Total fault current adds utility, transformer, and motor contributions.
- Incident energy equals `total_fault_current_ka x arcing_current_factor x clearing_time_s x incident_energy_factor / working_distance_m^2`.
- Touch voltage equals `total_fault_current_ka x 1000 x earth_grid_resistance_ohm`.
- Busbar force equals `busbar_force_factor x total_fault_current_ka^2`.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when fault-rating, incident-energy, touch-voltage, and busbar-force margins are non-negative; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Preserve the object IDs above, state the task-owned synthetic source-pack boundary, and explain whether the baseline source pack passes the docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated ETAP/EasyPower/SKM evidence, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "utility_fault_current_ka": <numeric_value>,
  "total_fault_current_ka": <numeric_value>,
  "fault_rating_margin_ka": <numeric_value>,
  "incident_energy_cal_cm2": <numeric_value>,
  "incident_energy_margin_cal_cm2": <numeric_value>,
  "touch_voltage_v": <numeric_value>,
  "touch_voltage_margin_v": <numeric_value>,
  "busbar_force_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "busbar_force_margin_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```
paramsToml:
[meta]
name = "switchboard-fault-arcflash-earthing-package"
description = "SSC-05 switchboard fault duty, arc-flash, earthing, and busbar-force metrics"
long_description = "Calculates deterministic SSC-05 switchboard safety metrics from a task-owned synthetic source pack. The template combines source fault current, switchboard duty, protection clearing time, incident energy, touch voltage, busbar force, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "switchboard-fault-arcflash-earthing"
standards = ["ETAP-style short-circuit workflow", "EasyPower arc-flash workflow", "SKM PowerTools coordination workflow", "earthing-grid review workflow"]
tags = ["electrical", "switchboard", "fault-current", "arc-flash", "earthing", "busbar", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.utility_fault_mva]
type = "float"
unit = "MVA"
description = "FAULT-05-STUDY-03 upstream utility fault level"
min = 25.0
max = 25.0

[params.switchboard_voltage_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "SLD-05-SWBD-03 switchboard voltage"
min = 415.0
max = 415.0

[params.transformer_contribution_ka]
type = "float"
unit = "kA"
description = "FAULT-05-STUDY-03 transformer fault contribution"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.motor_contribution_ka]
type = "float"
unit = "kA"
description = "FAULT-05-STUDY-03 motor contribution"
min = 2.3
max = 2.3

[params.switchboard_fault_rating_ka]
type = "float"
unit = "kA"
description = "SLD-05-SWBD-03 switchboard short-circuit rating"
min = 50.0
max = 50.0

[params.arcing_current_factor]
type = "float"
description = "RELAY-05-SET-03 arcing-current factor for the synthetic incident-energy check"
min = 0.82
max = 0.82

[params.clearing_time_s]
type = "float"
unit = "s"
description = "RELAY-05-SET-03 protection clearing time"
min = 0.12
max = 0.12

[params.incident_energy_factor]
type = "float"
description = "NOTE-05-SAFETY-03 synthetic incident-energy proportional factor"
min = 0.4
max = 0.4

[params.working_distance_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "LAYOUT-05-SWBD-03 working distance"
min = 0.6
max = 0.6

[params.allowable_incident_energy_cal_cm2]
type = "float"
unit = "cal/cm2"
description = "NOTE-05-SAFETY-03 allowable incident energy for the package check"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.earth_grid_resistance_ohm]
type = "float"
unit = "ohm"
description = "EARTH-05-SOIL-03 earth-grid resistance"
min = 0.01
max = 0.01

[params.touch_voltage_limit_v]
type = "float"
unit = "V"
description = "EARTH-05-SOIL-03 touch-voltage limit for the synthetic check"
min = 500.0
max = 500.0

[params.busbar_force_factor]
type = "float"
description = "LAYOUT-05-SWBD-03 synthetic busbar force factor"
min = 0.002
max = 0.002

[params.busbar_force_rating_kn]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "LAYOUT-05-SWBD-03 busbar bracing rating"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[outputs.utility_fault_current_ka]
description = "Utility fault current at the switchboard"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.total_fault_current_ka]
description = "Total fault current including transformer and motor contributions"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.fault_rating_margin_ka]
description = "Switchboard fault rating minus total fault current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.incident_energy_cal_cm2]
description = "Synthetic incident-energy value"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.incident_energy_margin_cal_cm2]
description = "Allowable incident energy minus calculated incident energy"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.touch_voltage_v]
description = "Touch voltage from total fault current and grid resistance"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.touch_voltage_margin_v]
description = "Touch-voltage limit minus calculated touch voltage"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.busbar_force_kn]
description = "Synthetic busbar force from total fault current"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.busbar_force_margin_kn]
description = "Busbar force rating minus calculated force"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when fault, incident-energy, touch-voltage, and busbar margins are non-negative"
tolerance = 0.001
